# CDAD — Context-Driven AI Development

> CDAD (Context-Driven AI Development) is an open-source methodology for governed AI-assisted software development. It treats project context as an explicit engineering artifact, with mechanisms for structuring, governing and protecting the context consumed by AI coding agents.

CDAD complements Spec-Driven Development (SDD): SDD makes specifications and expected behavior explicit, while CDAD governs the context and boundaries within which an AI coding agent implements them. Core concepts: Governed Context, Context Engineering, Context Governance, the Context Protection Pattern (CPP), Architectural Intent, Architectural Drift.

CDAD is agent-agnostic. It is used alongside AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot and others — it is a governance methodology, not an agent itself.

Created by Moisés Griott. Maintained by CDAD Community. Status: open-source project under active development. License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

## Documentation (English)

- [About CDAD](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/about): What CDAD is, its core principles, and how it addresses the challenges of AI-assisted software development.
- [The Problem](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/problem): The challenges AI agents face — context loss, architectural drift, uncontrolled changes, and inconsistent decisions.
- [The Approach](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/approach): How CDAD governs AI-assisted development through governed context, architecture, and protection patterns.
- [Ecosystem](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/ecosystem): How CDAD relates to SDD, Context Engineering, AI agents, and modern software development practices.
- [Methodology](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/methodology): Governance layers, freeze, change requests, ADRs, and architectural intent.
- [CDAD 2.1 — Current Reference Implementation](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/cdad-2-1): Workspace structure, governed context, and integration examples.
- [FAQ](https://cdad-community.github.io/en/faq): Common questions about CDAD, its relationship to SDD and RAG, agents, and how to get started.

## Documentación (Español)

- [Acerca de CDAD](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/acerca): Qué es CDAD, sus principios fundamentales y cómo aborda los desafíos del desarrollo de software asistido por IA.
- [El Problema](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/problema): Los desafíos que enfrentan los agentes de IA — pérdida de contexto, desviación arquitectónica, cambios incontrolados y decisiones inconsistentes.
- [El Enfoque](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/enfoque): Cómo CDAD gobierna el desarrollo asistido por IA a través de contexto gobernado, arquitectura y patrones de protección.
- [Ecosistema](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/ecosistema): Cómo CDAD se relaciona con SDD, Context Engineering, agentes de IA y prácticas modernas de desarrollo de software.
- [Metodología](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/metodologia): Capas de gobernanza, freeze, solicitudes de cambio, ADRs e intención arquitectónica.
- [CDAD 2.1 — Implementación de Referencia Actual](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/cdad-2-1): Estructura de workspace, contexto gobernado y ejemplos de integración.
- [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://cdad-community.github.io/es/preguntas-frecuentes): Preguntas comunes sobre CDAD, su relación con SDD y RAG, agentes y cómo empezar.

## Reference Implementation

- [cdad-bootstrap](https://github.com/CDAD-Community/cdad-bootstrap): Official open-source starter kit — governed context, architecture mapping, change requests, proposals, ADRs and agent rules.
